scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p src/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.arch.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test:e2e:pwa: npm run build:test && PW_PREVIEW=dist-test playwright test -c playwright.pwa.config.ts --project pwa
scripts.test:screens: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -e WORDCELL_SCREENS_CONTAINER=1 -v "$PWD":/work -v wordcell-screens-node-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble sh -c 'npm ci && npm run test:screens:run -- "$@"' screens
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:pwa
